title: Gelyn configuration
description: Settings gelyn reads from gelyn.json in the working directory, or from the file given to --config.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema, so that editors offer completion and validation.

Language.description: The language of the generated pages, written to the lang attribute of every document as a BCP 47 tag.

Author.description: The name written to the author meta tag. Omitted from the document when absent.

Description.description: The description written to the description meta tag by any page whose front matter declares none. Omitted from the document when absent.

BaseUrl.description: The absolute http or https URL the site is served from. Its path prefixes every link, and its origin gives each page a canonical URL.

EnableFeed.description: Writes a syndication feed of the pages whose front matter declares enableFeed. Requires BaseUrl, as every entry needs an absolute URL.

EnableSitemap.description: Writes a sitemap of the pages the site publishes. Requires BaseUrl, as every location in it is an absolute URL.

FooterLinks.description: Links listed in the footer of every page, in the order declared here. The feed and the sitemap are appended after them when the build publishes them.

Label.description: The text the link reads as.

Url.description: The absolute http or https URL the link addresses.

Theme.description: The bundled theme every page is styled with. Its stylesheet and script are written to the root of the output directory and linked ahead of the site's own. Unset, no theme is applied.

KaTeXVersion.description: The version of KaTeX requested from jsDelivr by a page whose front matter sets enableMathRendering.

MermaidVersion.description: The version of Mermaid requested from jsDelivr by a page whose front matter sets enableDiagramRendering.

ShikiVersion.description: The version of Shiki requested from jsDelivr by a page whose front matter sets enableSyntaxHighlighting.

Giscus.description: The GitHub Discussions backend a page declaring enableComments renders a comment thread from. Unset, no page renders one.

RepoId.description: The repository id the giscus configuration page shows.

Category.description: The discussion category giscus creates threads in.

CategoryId.description: The category id the giscus configuration page shows.

ContentDirectory.description: The directory the site is built from, holding the Markdown sources and anything published beside them. Relative values are resolved against the working directory.

OutputDirectory.description: The directory the generated site is written to. Relative values are resolved against the working directory. Existing files are overwritten.

ExcludePatterns.description: Patterns naming the entries the build leaves out, matched case insensitively against the name of each file and directory rather than against its path, with * and ? as the only wildcards. A directory that matches is not descended into. Nothing is excluded by default.

Port.description: The loopback port gelyn serve listens on, read once when the server starts.
